# Local presentation libraries

These unmodified, pinned distributions are stored locally so the website can run without an Internet connection.

| File | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jquery.min.js` | jQuery 3.7.1 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jquery@3.7.1/dist/jquery.min.js | MIT: https://github.com/jquery/jquery/blob/3.7.1/LICENSE.txt |
| `bootstrap.min.css` | Bootstrap 5.3.8 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css | MIT: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.8/LICENSE |
| `bootstrap.bundle.min.js` | Bootstrap 5.3.8 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js | MIT: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.8/LICENSE |

Bootstrap 5 uses JavaScript for its components. ReFind uses jQuery separately for the DOM and event-handling techniques taught in Week 4. Each distribution retains its upstream license notice; the full license texts are in `LICENSES.txt`.
